Hi, I believe you're mistaken. 
The error indicates that the mockbank is comparing the organisation_id with the software_statement_id. Perhaps it is comparing the BRSEAL certificate instead of the BRCAC?

The organisation ID is: `effb6cae-e6d6-5f0b-8f31-ee7922850300`

The softwarestatement ID is: `ab03cc21-3ffb-46bc-b197-95f8d9fa9153`

The tls subject from the certificate is:

```
subject=C=BR, ST=BRASILIA, L=BRASILIA, O=BRB - BCO DE BRASILIA S.A., CN=lina.sandbox.com.br, serialNumber=00000208000100, businessCategory=Business Entity, jurisdictionC=BR, organizationIdentifier=OFBBR-effb6cae-e6d6-5f0b-8f31-ee7922850300, UID=ab03cc21-3ffb-46bc-b197-95f8d9fa9153
```

The error description is: 
```
software_statement not approved for use with presented client tls certificate or no client tls certificate presented. expected x509 CN or UID: eb13a231-4fb3-4777-a204-a2b22e8a14ec, actual x509: UID=ab03cc21-3ffb-46bc-b197-95f8d9fa9153,2.5.4.97=%23132A4F464242522D65666662366361652D653664362D356630622D386633312D656537393232383530333030,jurisdictionC=BR,businessCategory=Business%20Entity,serialNumber=00000208000100,CN=lina.sandbox.com.br,O=BRB%20-%20BCO%20DE%20BRASILIA%20S.A.,L=BRASILIA,ST=BRASILIA,C=BR"}
```

Either way, the error message indicates it is comparing the wrong ID.
Can you please take a closer look?
